title: Grandparents with Grandchildren, 1940s B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from the 1940s featuring an elderly couple standing behind two young girls outdoors in front of a home with wooden siding. The girls wear winter coats and beret hats, with one coat featuring a prominent lace collar. The photo has classic scalloped borders typical of mid-20th-century family photography.
